title: A phase's branch is cut by the verb that starts its work
desiredOutcome: starting a phase's first task cuts its branch from the resolved parent (or refuses and says why), a started task on another branch is refused, and doctor names a running phase with no branch - so no phase runs outside the protocol in silence

findings.issue: phase entry cases exercised only the single-file layout; the sharded shard/stub write was proven by no case

review.outcome: matches the desired outcome; one low finding fixed in P64.4-uym

summary: audit-task start now performs phase entry: a phase's first task cuts its branch from the resolved parent (or records the one /audit:worktree add checked out) and writes branch and baseRef, rolling the write back if git refuses; it refuses a start off the parent, detached, before the first commit, on a taken or illegal name, and - for a phase that records a branch - from any other branch. /audit:doctor names a running phase with no branch. resolve-branch, worktree add and start now compose the name through one answer (worktree add had ignored git user.name for {initials}). Desired outcome met: no phase starts its work outside the protocol in silence. This phase was itself run on its own branch in a linked worktree; its invariant check examined branch history and baseRef, both clean. Reviewed in phase mode (one finding, fixed); the phase gate ran green with the tree unchanged.

tasks.title: start performs phase entry: the first task cuts the phase branch from the resolved parent, and a task on another branch is refused
tasks.description: Phase entry (orchestrator.md) was prose the orchestrator ran before start, so every phase driven through the verbs ran with no branch. start now performs it: resolve the name and parent through the same code resolve-branch.py uses (moved into _branch), refuse when HEAD is not the parent, is detached, has no commit, or the name is taken or illegal, write branch and baseRef, revalidate, then git switch -c - rolling the write back if git refuses. A phase that records a branch refuses a start from any other branch. Outside a git repository the phase runs with no branch and the output says so.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py: start cuts the branch, records branch and baseRef, and refuses off the parent, detached, unborn, a taken name and another branch
plugins/audit/tests/test_manage_worktrees.py: a4 worktree add composes the name start expects

outcome.technical: met - start performs phase entry (cut, adopt, refuse, no-git); one branch answer for resolve-branch, worktree add and start; each arm red first
outcome.descriptive: Starting the first task of a phase now puts its work on its own branch - cut from the right parent, or refused with the reason - so no phase runs outside the protocol unnoticed.
